# An override resolves through the imports of the file it is written in.
#
# Imports bind per file, and a program's override used to be resolved in
# whichever file's scope was current when overrides were collected -- the last
# one loaded. So an override whose file sorted before a sibling lost its own
# imports: here `html` in the target and `t` in the body, neither of which
# zz.sngl imports.

sngl check main.sngl
stdout 'main.sngl: ok'

sngl generate --platform=html --lang=none --out=ht main.sngl
! grep 'base' ht/index.html

-- main.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "lib"

output {
    none {
        html
    }
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    lib.Box()
}
-- lib/box.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import t "sngl:time"
import "sngl:platform/html"

component Box() node {
    text(value="base")
}

component Box[html.platform] {
    var d t.duration = 5ms
    text(value="{d}")
}
-- lib/zz.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component Other() node {
    text(value="other")
}
